name: Copper/Gold Ratio & SPY Forward Returns
description: Analyzes the copper/gold ratio (HG/GC) as a macro regime indicator for S&P 500 forward returns. Defines "rising" regime as ratio above its 50-day MA (economic optimism) and "falling" as below (risk aversion). Measures 63-day (~3 month) forward returns on SPY in each regime. Exhibits: ratio time series with MA overlay, regime return comparison bars, and event markers at each regime flip.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio & SPY Forward Returns
# Thesis: Rising copper/gold = economic optimism → stocks rally
#         Falling copper/gold = risk aversion → stocks struggle
# Regime: ratio above/below its 50-day MA

# --- Data ---
ts = index()()
src = market_data_source()()
spy_close = src.c

# Load copper (HG) and gold (GC) — NoAdjustment for cross-commodity ratio (D16)
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# ffill reference data to align with SPY calendar
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
ratio = hg_close / gc_close
ratio_ma50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# --- Regime Definition ---
# Rising = ratio above 50d MA (economic optimism)
# Falling = ratio below 50d MA (risk aversion)
is_rising = ratio > ratio_ma50

# Regime flips for event markers
flip_to_rising = crossover(ratio, ratio_ma50)
flip_to_falling = crossunder(ratio, ratio_ma50)
any_flip = flip_to_rising or flip_to_falling

# --- SPY Forward Returns (63 trading days ≈ 3 months) ---
spy_fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns
rising_fwd = where(is_rising, spy_fwd_63d)
falling_fwd = where(not is_rising, spy_fwd_63d)

# Regime label for bar chart (1 = Rising, 2 = Falling)
regime_label = 1.0 if is_rising else 2.0

# --- Event Markers: Regime Flips ---
flip_direction = "Rising (Optimism)" if flip_to_rising else "Falling (Risk-Off)"
flip_ratio_val = where(any_flip, ratio)
flip_spy_price = where(any_flip, spy_close)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Cu/Au Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_direction, flip_ratio_val, flip_spy_price, any_flip)

# --- Chart 1: Copper/Gold Ratio with 50d MA (Context) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio: Where Are We in the Macro Cycle?',
    category='Cu/Au Macro Signal',
    y_axis_label='HG/GC Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_axis_label='',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cu/Au Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts.value, y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma50))

# --- Chart 2: Median 3M SPY Return by Regime (Punchline) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Economic Optimism Pay? Median 3M SPY Return by Regime',
    category='Cu/Au Macro Signal',
    x_axis_label='',
    y_axis_label='Median 3M Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rising (Optimism)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Falling (Risk-Off)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(rising_fwd, falling_fwd))
